components.css: :host{--bg:#16181d;--panel:#1b1e24;--raise:#23272f;--seam:#2c313a;--seam-2:#3b414c;--text:#e6e8eb;--text-2:#b3bac6;--text-3:#8f97a5;--faint:#4b5263;--accent:#7aa2f7;--accent-ink:#0f1420;--accent-wash:rgba(122,162,247,.14);--note:#e0af68;--note-wash:rgba(224,175,104,.10);--font:'Source Sans 3',system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:'Source Code Pro',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;--r:5px;} .ds-gaps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,250px);gap:1px;background:var(--seam);border:1px solid var(--seam);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden}.ds-gap{all:unset;cursor:pointer;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:2px 12px;font:400 14.5px var(--font)}.ds-gap b{grid-row:1/3;font:600 24px/1.1 var(--mono);min-width:4.2ch;text-align:right}.ds-gap .lbl{font-weight:600}.ds-gap .why{color:var(--text-3);font-size:13px}.ds-gap:hover{background:var(--raise)}.ds-gap[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-wash)}.ds-gap[aria-pressed=true] b,.ds-gap[aria-pressed=true] .lbl{color:var(--accent)}.ds-gap:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:-2px}

narrative.overview:
The explorer is a dark-first developer console for a genealogy of scholars. Every job owns a fixed tile: header across the top, view rail on the left, the canvas in the centre with a title row above it and a status row and list strip beneath it, the record on the right. Tiles are divided by 1px seams, never by gaps, cards, or shadows, so the screen reads as one machined surface cut into compartments. Selecting anything updates canvas, record, and list in place; the record and strip acknowledge it with a 150ms seam flash.

Density is high and calm: small type, tabular figures, hairline rules between rows, one cool accent. Colour carries meaning only. Blue is the user's attention (focus, selection, the traced path); amber is the data's voice (notes, stamped states, cohort); the three category hues and the amber cohort ramp colour nodes on the canvas and nowhere else. The world rejects the floating-toolbar canvas with overlays stacked on the graph, and the white SaaS card dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground with two lifted panel tones; depth by tone and seam, not shadow.
Source Sans 3 for words, Source Code Pro for every figure.
Panel and section headers in tiny tracked uppercase; person names large and bold.
Controls live in the flow above or beside the canvas, never on top of it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue means "you are here or you chose this": focus, selection, traced path. It is never decoration, never a category, never a heading colour.

rules.name: The Amber Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber belongs to the data: notes, stamped states, health counts, cohort. A note is amber and upright, never italic.

rules.name: The Canvas-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Category hues and the cohort ramp colour nodes and their key swatches only; chrome stays graphite and blue.

rules.name: The Figures-in-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every count, year, rank and statistic is set in Source Code Pro.

rules.name: The Names-Never-Mono Rule
rules.body: Person and institution names are always Source Sans 3, even inside a stat row (the text variant of a stat value switches back to the sans).

rules.name: The Fixed Tile Rule
rules.body: Every job has a fixed tile. Controls, legends and lists sit in the flow beside the canvas; nothing floats over the drawing.

rules.name: The Seam-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Tiles at rest never cast shadows; they are separated by a 1px seam.

dos: Do divide every tile and row with a 1px Seam; build grids as 1px gaps over a Seam ground.
Do reserve Workbench Blue for focus, selection and the traced path, with Accent Ink for text on it.
Do set every figure in Source Code Pro and every name in Source Sans 3.
Do put data notes and stamped states in amber, upright, on Note Wash.
Do keep canvas controls, legends and lists in the toolbar, status row and strip.
Do colour nodes only from the three category hues, Other, or the amber cohort ramp.
donts: Don't float toolbars, legends or overlays on the graph canvas.
Don't give resting tiles shadows or turn the shell into white SaaS cards.
Don't use the accent as decoration, a category, or a heading colour.
Don't italicise notes or set names in mono.
Don't use Faint for readable text.
Don't introduce a rainbow for the cohort ramp; it stays one amber hue.
